description: kotoba-datomic-projection snapshot — top-N most recent `app.bsky.feed.post` records across all DIDs observed by the projection daemon, sorted by indexedAt desc. Per ADR-2605231500. This is a *derived* read path: the canonical record is each DID's own MST entry; this projection only exists to make Discover-feed reads O(1) instead of O(DIDs × listRecords). The projector daemon (see `50-infra/mst-projector/`) consumes `com.atproto.sync.subscribeRepos`, maintains the index in memory, and emits one snapshot per flush boundary. Rebuild: replay the firehose from cursor 0 — see `50-infra/mst-projector/projection/REBUILD.md`. Conformance: L0-projection (line-comment + manifest, manual rebuild). L1 upgrade pending CI replay smoke.

snapshotAt.description: Wall-clock time the projector emitted this snapshot. NOT used for ordering — sorting is by `items[*].indexedAt`.

cursor.description: Last firehose `seq` consumed before emission. A replay consumer can resume from this point + this snapshot for monotonic-progress rebuild.

firstSeq.description: First firehose `seq` represented in `items`. With `cursor` this delimits the seq range covered.

items.description: Top-N most recent posts, sorted by indexedAt desc. Bounded so one snapshot fits in a single AT record (~64 KiB budget). For longer history, replay older snapshots via TID order.

totalSeen.description: Lifetime count of distinct (did, rkey) entries the projector has observed for `app.bsky.feed.post`. Used by L1-projection conformance smoke to detect index drift.

projectionLevel.description: Conformance level of the emitting projector. L0 = manifest+runbook only; L1 = CI-exercised rebuild; L2 = byte-identical 1% replay smoke.

indexedAt.description: Sort key. Primary source: `record.createdAt`. Fallback: firehose commit `time` (when createdAt missing or in the future).

textPreview.description: First chars of `record.text` (post-Charter-Rider scrubbing). Truncated to 600 chars so 500 items fit in ~300 KiB. Renderer should call `com.atproto.repo.getRecord` for full content + facets + embeds.

verdict.description: If a FeedPostCell (`20-actors/magatama/cells/feed_post/`) verdict has been observed for this record, propagate the kind. `reject` records are NOT promoted into the projection. Default `unverdicted` (no verdict observed yet — common for fresh writes pre-membrane).
